text:
Since you didn't reply within 3 days of our out-of-stock email, the affected item was automatically refunded. Nothing further is needed from you.

Once a refund is issued, it goes to your original payment method and takes 5-10 business days for cards or 3-5 business days for digital wallets. If you'd prefer, I can't switch it to store credit myself based on the excerpts I have, but I can escalate to a Support Lead if you'd like to ask about that.

If the refund hasn't shown up after those timeframes, send me your order number (LF- plus six digits) and I'll help from there.
